metaTitle: Custom Performance Headbands & Wristbands | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom performance headbands and wristbands for your team. Moisture-wicking fabric keeps employees cool and focused. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Performance headbands and wristbands are designed for active environments where sweat and heat can slow down your team. Unlike basic cotton options, these use moisture-wicking polyester or microfiber that pulls sweat away from the skin, keeping employees dry during warehouse shifts, outdoor events, or trade show setups. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a durable, professional look that holds up through repeated washing and heavy use.
heroAltText: Custom performance headbands and wristbands in moisture-wicking fabric with printed logo for sports and work
